blurb: Coosa River Outfitters offers professionally guided fishing trips targeting blue catfish, flathead catfish, crappie, bluegill, and redear sunfish on the Coosa River and Lake Weiss. Trips include premium rods, reels, bait, and tackle. They also provide guided outdoor adventures such as thermal predator hunting, night vision coyote hunts, and guided beaver hunts in northwest Georgia.
